objective: Prove, for a law composing like cycles and two knots of a system that share exactly one distinction with a common range: each is a complete contact; forgetting the shared distinction gives one knot on all their other distinctions, so nothing is lost or tied; the pair is never a common hub; the composite depends only on allowed states and is the law's own projection; composition persists under recodings, erasures and restrictions by the law's own relations, and under pinning exactly when the law with constants still composes like cycles (affine laws over finite fields; not parity beside J or K4); isomorphisms and pp-definitions transport it, homomorphic equivalence and products do not.
status: Proved by NATIVE-NETWORK-20261021-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with explicit and randomized checks; the top lemma, Latin and affine tops, and the utility, tractability and loop-homology proofs cited). In a law composing like cycles, two knots sharing one distinction with a common range are complete contacts whose composite, by forgetting the shared distinction, is one knot on all their other distinctions: nothing lost, nothing tied, no hub, decided by allowed states and the law's own projection, carried by recodings. Composition persists under erasure and restriction by the law's relations, and under pinning exactly when the law with constants still composes like cycles (affine laws over finite fields; not parity beside J or K4). Isomorphisms and pp-definitions transport it; homomorphic equivalence and products do not. So such pairs pass the contact-network gate under those admitted maps; S3's passing pairs show that pairs alone do not certify a law.
title: Proof: the native-network gate audit
